decisions.statement: A file whose body the record already holds whole is owed no body.
A file the agent read only part of is owed its body.
A file whose body moved since the agent read it is owed its body.
A file that will not open is owed its body rather than passed over.
The order the files were left in is kept.
Nothing here reads or writes a page.

definition: which of the files a read left over the agent still owes a body for
